title: The 10 Best Oil Drain Pans
subtitle: Open drain pans and sealed oil drain containers for oil changes and coolant, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A good drain pan catches every drop of an oil change and gets it to the recycling center without a spill. We ranked 10 best-sellers from NEIKO, Performance Tool, CHAPIN, Scepter and others on rating, review volume and features (a sealed container, 12 quarts or more, a low profile and a drain-plug screen).

buyers_guide.q: How much capacity do I need?
buyers_guide.a: Check your engine's oil capacity and add a few quarts. Most cars take 4 to 6 quarts; trucks and diesels can take 8 to 15.
Open pans are easy to drain into and clean. Sealed containers let you cap the used oil and carry it to a recycling center without spilling.
ATVs, mowers and lowered cars need a pan under about 5 inches tall.
A screen catches the drain plug when it drops, so you don't fish it out of hot oil, and gives the old filter a place to drain.
Most auto parts stores and many recycling centers take used oil and filters for free. Never pour it out.
